snippet.title: BOOMER | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
BOOMER is a chaotic co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge eerie environments, feed your loot to a hungry steam engine, and pass Boomer between teammates in a deadly game of hot potato.

Play BOOMER now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353060/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=boomer_launch&utm_content=launch_trailer
